mine: he breaks out against all sound judgment
note: Hebrew bekol-tushiyyah yitgalla' means "he bursts out (quarrels) against all sound wisdom" (cf. 17:14, 20:3); the KJV turns a censure of the loner into a commendation of study.
Hebrew mitlahamim (also 26:22) means "things swallowed greedily, tidbits"; the KJV guessed "wounds".

kjv: A man [that hath] friends must shew himself friendly
mine: A man of many companions may come to ruin
note: Hebrew lehitro'ea is from ra'a' "be broken", i.e. many shallow friends lead to ruin, contrasted with one true friend; the KJV derived it from rea' "friend".
